content: धृ I. €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> (Supposed by some to be a passive form of धृ) ; (ध्रियते, धृत) .²1 To be or exist, live, continue to live, survive; आर्यपुत्र ध्रिये एषा ध्रिये <ls>U. 3</ls>; ध्रियते यावदेकोऽपि रिपुस्तावत्कुतः सुखम् <ls>Śi. 2. 35</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">15. 89</ls>; नष्टा शरीरैः क्रतुभिर्धरन्ते <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 To be maintained or preserved, remain, continue; सुरतश्रमसंभृतो मुखे ध्रियते स्वेदलवोद्गमोऽपि ते <ls>R. 8. 51</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 18</ls>. .²3 To resolve upon. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (धरति, usually धारयति-ते, धृत, धारित) .²1 To hold, bear, carry; भुजङ्गमपि कोपितं शिरसि पुष्पवद्धारयेत् <ls>Bh. 2. 4</ls>; वैणवीं धारयेद्यष्टिं सोदकं च कमण्डलुम् <ls>Ms. 4. 36</ls>; <ls>Bk. 17. 54</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 36</ls>. .²2 To hold or bear up, maintain, support, sustain; अभिनवजलधरसुन्दर धृतमन्दर … … <ls>Gīt. 1. 2. 7</ls>; यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि धरा धारयते समम् <ls>Ms. 9. 311</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 126</ls>; प्रातःकुन्दप्रसवशिथिलं जीवितं धारयेथाः <ls>Me. 115</ls>; चिरमात्मना धृताम् <ls>R. 3. 35</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 29</ls>. .²3 To hold in oneʼs possession, possess, have, keep; या संस्कृता धार्यते <ls>Bh. 2. 19</ls>. .²4 To assume, take (as a form, disguise <ab>&c.</ab>); केशव धृतसूकररूप <ls>Gīt. 1. 1. 4</ls>; धारयति कोकनदरूपम् <ls n="Gīt.">10. 4</ls>. .²5 To wear, put on, use (clothes, ornaments <ab>&c.</ab>); श्रितकमलाकुचमण्डल धृतकुण्डल ए <ls>Gīt. 1. 2. 1</ls>. .²6 To hold in check, curb, restrain, stop, detain; त्वया हि धर्मो विधृतः कृत्स्नं धारयते जगत् <ls>Mb. 1. 63. 5</ls>; दधार द्रोणमायान्तं वेलेव सरितां पतिम् <ls>Mb. 7. 16. 21</ls>. .²7 To fix upon, direct towards; (with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab>) ब्राह्मण्ये धृतमानसः, मनो दध्रे राजसूयाय <ab>&c.</ab> .²8 To suffer, undergo. .²9 To assign anything to any person, allot, assign. .²10 To owe anything to a person (with <ab>dat.</ab>; rarely <ab>gen.</ab> of person, 10 only in this sense); वृक्षसेचने द्वे धारयसि मे <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; तस्मै तस्य वा धनं धारयति <ab>&c.</ab> .²11 To hold, contain. .²12 To observe, practise. .²13 To cite, quote. .²14 To keep, retain (in oneʼs service). .²15 To preserve, maintain. .²16 To seize, lay hold of. .²17 To hold out or on, endure. .²18 To fix, place, deposit. .²19 To intend in mind; स यद्यदेवासृजत तत्तदत्तुमाध्रियत <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 2. 5</ls>. (The senses of this root may be variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} मनसा धृ to bear in mind, remember; शिरसा, मूर्ध्नि धृ to bear on the head, respect highly; अन्तरे धृ to pledge, deposit anything as surety; समये धृ to bring to terms or agreement; दण्डं धृ to punish, chastise, use force; जीवितम्, प्राणान्, गात्रम्, शरीरम्, देहम् <ab>&c.</ab> धृ to continue to live, maintain the soul <ab>&c.</ab>; preserve the vital spirits; व्रतं धृ to observe a vow; इत्थं व्रतं धारयतः प्रजार्थम् <ls>R. 2. 25</ls>; तुलया धृ to hold in a balance, weigh <ab>&c.</ab>; मनः, मतिम्, चित्तम्, बुद्धिम् धृ to bend the mind to a thing, fix the mind upon, think of, resolve upon; गर्भं धृ to become pregnant, conceive; धारणां धृ to practise concentration or self-control <ab>&c.</ab>)
